scenes.headline: Humanity just passed eight billion
scenes.narration: In November 2022 the world population passed eight billion. It took only twelve years to add the last billion.

scenes.headline: World population since 1960
scenes.narration: In 1960 there were about three billion of us. By 2000 it was just over six billion, and today it is around eight.

scenes.headline: Twelve years for the last billion
scenes.narration: Seven billion arrived in 2011. Eight billion arrived in 2022, a gap of about twelve years.

scenes.headline: Growth is slowing down
scenes.narration: The yearly growth rate has been falling for decades, and the United Nations expects the total to level off later this century.

scenes.headline: Numbers behind the news
scenes.narration: Follow for one chart a week that makes the headlines easier to read.
